T_convention: T_imu_cam maps camera points to the measured IMU frame; copied directly, never inverted
noise_note: IntegrationBase squares these parameters and multiplies noise Jacobians by dt. Discrete mode converts density/random-walk to per-sample std using sqrt(rate). Original midpoint covariance ignores adjacent-sample correlation; not an exact continuous-noise covariance discretization. legacy-density copies values for a separately labelled sensitivity replay.
input_contract: mono8 calibrated left camera; measured SI IMU specific force and angular velocity in matching IMU frame; no gravity subtraction
optimization: fixed measured extrinsics, original point and line gates, no loop closure/GPS/wheel/ToF/depth inputs
